user_statement: ok tu peux les ajoutés aux autres :) . Maintenant j'aimerais que tu me fasses une séries de monstres que toi tu aurais imaginé en te basant directement sur ce que tu sais de notre univers :)
creative_scope: Original creature proposals derived directly from current Project RL campaign motifs; no external game treated as design reference in these prompts.
preview_title: Monstres de notre univers · propositions originales · taille native

records.label: Traîne-carcan
records.universe_basis: Carcans mécaniques employés par le culte pour asservir les démons, puis réseau brisé.
records.setting_proposal: Fin des accès / installations de contrainte — association proposée, après les premières rencontres de cultistes humains.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE ORIGINAL ordinary monster for Project RL, designed from its OWN world: a grim cyberpunk apocalypse caused by a technoreligious cult's failed demon enslavement. Prisoner expeditions descend through seized human facilities into a genuine demonic ice prison realm.
The attached approved PLAYER + WEAPON drawing is ONLY the GRAPHIC STYLE reference. Match its clean dark comic contours, large flat color masses, TWO or THREE values per material, one broad purposeful shadow plane and sparse broad highlights. Do not copy the human, armor, helmet, sword or shield. This must look drawn by the same artist as the existing player and weapons, not photorealistic, pre-rendered 3D, noisy or over-rendered.
The new silhouette must read at64px-per-cell game scale. Mature unsettling creature proportions, broad simplified anatomy, very few internal subdivisions, no cute mascot, chibi, bobblehead, fine pores, rows of tiny teeth, miniature scratches, many little wires, scales or excessive bone parts. Large flesh areas use warm beige/ochre/grey-brown, no bright pink. Human clothing or braces, if specified, are worn industrial fabric and utilitarian equipment rather than heroic armor.
Exactly ONE whole creature, ONE static grounded pose, nearly frontal with slight overhead view, every extremity attached and inside generous genuinely transparent ALPHA margins. No other figure, reference inset, labels, text, background, floor, baked shadow, glow, active spell, particle, smoke or animated effect. Contact shadow is composed separately later. No explicit wounds or exposed internal organs.
Ordinary troop candidate, never a sector boss or leader: no crown, halo, regal cape, rank insignia, throne or triumph pose. This is an appearance proposal only. Do not define stats, spells, abilities, density, combat rules or animation. Final native body limits are specified below; draw a full source suitable for a direct native export, not a sheet of enlarged sprites.
Subject:
One low broad FOUR-LEGGED demon, native44px high and at most80px wide. Hairless warm grey-beige body with heavy shoulder hump, small flat eyeless head, long weight-bearing forelegs and short rear legs ending in broad charcoal claws. A SINGLE huge broken dull brass-and-charcoal industrial restraint ring remains around the lower neck, two thick separated ends angled outward like an OPEN clamp, no tiny chain links. A broad scar-colored band beneath it is closed skin, no wound. Short coarse tail. The creature is clearly living flesh marked by a failed human control device. The big broken ring is its single main visual sign. No muzzle mask, horns, teeth rows, many wires or armor suit.

references.role: Trait, aplats et ombres du joueur et de ses armes uniquement
